title: Airlock Gamma Override Console
author: Station Management System
content:
AIRLOCK GAMMA — MANUAL OVERRIDE CONSOLE

The portside maintenance corridor has been sealed under emergency lockdown protocol. Standard atmospheric equalization is offline. Magnetic seal integrity reads at 94%. Hydraulic pressure is nominal.

Manual override is available to authorized personnel.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

lines: >> STATUS: EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN — MAGNETIC SEAL ENGAGED

on_complete.message: Airlock Gamma groans open with a rush of stale, recycled air. The portside maintenance corridor stretches ahead — dark and cold, but passable. Emergency lighting flickers in amber strips along the floor.

on_failure.message: SECURITY LOCKOUT ENGAGED. Terminal access revoked. Airlock remains sealed. Security team has been notified.

title: Security Camera Override — Zone 4
author: Security Subsystem
content:
SECURITY CAMERA MANAGEMENT — ZONE 4

Zone 4 surveillance feeds are active across 3 camera clusters. Live monitoring is enabled. Disabling cameras will create a blind spot for approximately 12 minutes before automatic failover restores coverage.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

options: CLUSTER B — Cargo Bay Entrance (2 cameras)
CLUSTER C — Emergency Exit Passage (2 cameras)
ALL CLUSTERS — Full Zone Blackout (7 cameras)

lines: >> !! NO TRACE LEFT IN STANDARD AUDIT LOG !!

on_complete.message: The camera feeds flicker and freeze on their last frames. A looped recording now plays on the monitoring station — to anyone watching, the corridors appear empty and still. You have approximately 12 minutes before the system's failover detects the loop.

on_failure.message: OVERRIDE REJECTED. Camera feeds remain active. Anomalous access pattern flagged for security review.

title: Encrypted Research Data — Extraction Console
author: Archive Management System
content:
RESEARCH DATA ARCHIVE — EXTRACTION CONSOLE

This terminal provides access to encrypted research files stored in the Level 3 archive. Data extraction requires mounting an external storage device and initiating a secure transfer protocol.

WARNING: Unauthorized data extraction is a capital offense under Corporate Security Directive 7-Alpha.

[INTERACTIVE TERMINAL — AWAITING INPUT]

on_complete.message: The data drive's indicator light glows steady green — 342 megabytes of encrypted research files successfully extracted. The transfer logs have been wiped, but the archive's access counter has incremented. Someone thorough might notice.

on_failure.message: TRANSFER ABORTED. External device ejected. Security alert triggered — data remains in archive.
